name: PageFairy — Admin Approval (Campaign Created)

nodes.name: Campaign For Review Webhook
nodes.notes: Called by Hono after campaign record is created in Airtable with status=pending_approval. Expected body: { campaign_id, campaign_name, username, product_name, wholesale_cost, retail_price, goal_units, tech_chat_id, tech_record_id }

notes: PART 1 of admin approval flow. Sends notification to admin with Approve/Reject inline keyboard. PART 2 (callback handling — approve_* and reject_*) is in onboarding-flow.json, which handles all incoming Telegram updates including admin callback queries. Requires env vars: AIRTABLE_BASE_ID, AIRTABLE_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID. Requires n8n credential: PageFairy Telegram.
